metaDescription: Buy Counter-Strike 2 weapon skins, knives and gloves from {brand}. Each item is delivered to your Steam account by {method} after payment is confirmed.

hero.title: Counter-Strike 2 skins, sent to your Steam inventory
hero.lead: Weapon skins, knives and gloves for {game}. Every listing is one item in one condition, with its exterior and float range shown before you pay.

featured.title: Covert, knives and gloves
featured.lead: The rarest grades in the catalogue, one per weapon.

delivery.title: How delivery works
delivery.lead: There is no parcel. Each item arrives as a {method} from a delivery account.

account.title: Sign in with Steam
account.body: Link the Steam account that should receive the items. We only read your public Steam ID and profile name.

tradeUrl.title: Save your trade URL
tradeUrl.body: Paste the trade URL from your Steam inventory settings. We check that it belongs to the linked account.

pay.title: Pay on the secure page
pay.body: Card payment runs on our payment provider's page. We confirm the price again before you pay.

accept.title: Accept the trade offer
accept.body: We send the offer {usual}. Accept it in Steam before it expires. Steam can hold or protect received items for up to {protection} days; without the Mobile Authenticator a hold can last up to {hold} days.
